The circulation norm is rL max|w_t|. Dualizing an invariant cut projection gives Q=I-T_w^T, whose exact norm is max_t{|1-d w_t|+L sum|w_s|-d|w_t|}. Choosing t with w_t<=1/r proves the lower bound, attained by all weights 1/r. All boundary values n>=3,r>=1 follow algebraically. Exact rational checker reproduced 94,060 assertions for n=3..7,r=1..4; finite checks are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: Two exact complementary projection constants across the natural two-parameter family of uniformly subdivided complete graphs are established, with sharp minimizers and a new strict cost ordering reversal for n>=5 from r=1 to r>=2. The structural calculation explains why subdivisions keep the flow projection constant but alter the cut complement cost; it answers a motivated Banach-space invariant rather than an arbitrary small numerical slice.
